en.t: After the pilgrimage offering, Bungo no Suke spoke again:

units.source_text: “除了八幡神明之外，佛菩萨之中，椿市长谷寺的观音菩萨，在日本国内最为灵验，连中国也都闻名，何况国内。

en.t: Apart from the deities of Hachiman, among all the buddhas and bodhisattvas, the Bodhisattva Kannon of Hasedera at Tsubaichi is the most miraculously efficacious in Japan; her fame has even reached China, to say nothing of our own country.

units.source_text: 虽然远客他乡，但长年礼佛，小姐必蒙福佑。”

en.t: Though you are a traveler far from home, my lady, because you have worshiped the Buddha for many years, you will surely receive blessed protection.”

units.source_text: 便带她到长谷寺去礼拜观音菩萨。

en.t: He then took her to Hasedera to worship the Bodhisattva Kannon.

units.source_text: 为表示虔诚，决定徒步前往。

en.t: To show their devotion, they decided to go on foot.

units.source_text: 玉鬘不惯步行，心甚害怕，又感痛苦，只得听人引导，糊里糊涂地走去。

en.t: Tamakazura was not used to walking; frightened and in pain, she could only let others guide her and stumble along in a daze.

units.source_text: “我前世作了何等大孽，以致今世如此受苦？

en.t: “What terrible sin did I commit in a former life, that I must suffer like this in this one?

units.source_text: 假令我母已经不在人世，她若爱我，应请早日唤我到她所在的世间；

en.t: If my mother is no longer in this world, then if she loves me, may she call me soon to the world where she dwells;

units.source_text: 她如果还活在世间，应该让我见一见面！”

en.t: and if she is still alive in this world, she should let me see her just once!”

units.source_text: 她在心中如此向佛祈愿。

en.t: In her heart, she prayed to the Buddha in this way.

units.source_text: 然而她连母亲的面貌也不记得，过去只是一心希望母亲还在世间，因而悲伤叹息；

en.t: Yet she did not even remember her mother's face; in the past she had only hoped with all her heart that her mother was still in this world, and had grieved and sighed over it;

units.source_text: 现在身受苦难，更加悲伤了。

en.t: now, suffering hardship herself, she became still more sorrowful.

units.source_text: 吃尽千辛万苦，好容易走到了椿市地方，已是离京第四日的巳时。

en.t: After enduring every kind of hardship, they finally managed to reach the area of Tsubaichi; by then it was the Hour of the Snake on the fourth day since they had left the capital.

units.source_text: 到达之时，疲乏得不像一个活人了。

en.t: When she arrived, she was so exhausted that she scarcely seemed like a living person.
